Four variations of each scenario followed a 2 × 2 design: the protagonists either harmed another person (negative outcome) or did no harm (neutral outcome) or the protagonists either believed that they would cause harm (negative intention) or believed that they would cause no harm (neutral intention).
Following the protocol reported elsewhere,3 ,10 we presented the participants with 24 scenarios.

After reading each story, the participants were asked to rate the scenario on a Likert scale ranging from totally permissible (7) to totally forbidden (1) (details in eAppendix 1.1.1 in the Supplement).
